claims.text: The woman in the technical jacket rides the dragon into an epic battleground, a cinematic Hollywood scene with dramatic expressions and camera movements.
The woman has short dark hair with close-cropped sides and a small topknot, a light-to-medium complexion and a faint linear mark on one cheek.
She wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with straps and metal buckles, a dark undershirt, black tactical trousers and black lace-up combat boots.
The creature is a large black or charcoal dragon with heavy scales, multiple long pale horns, a spiked dorsal crest, clawed limbs, a long spiked tail and large membranous wings.
An orchestral score with low brass and driving percussion swells through the dive and lands on a sustained chord at the roar.

soundscape: Rushing wind and heavy wingbeats over a distant battle din, with crackling embers, grinding rubble and a deep draconic roar.
music: Broad orchestral score: low brass swells and driving taiko-like percussion underneath the dive, resolving onto a sustained brass chord as the dragon rears and roars.

description.text: A wall of black smoke tears apart above a scorched battleground of shattered stone, sunken trenches and guttering ember fires. Through the breach bursts
, wings spread to their full span, pale horns cutting the haze as the body tips into a steep dive toward the ruined field. Astride its shoulders, just behind the horns,
leans low into the descent, her technical jacket snapping in the rush of air, one hand locked around a ridge of scale. Far below, broken banners and scattered armour glint in the ember light.
The smoke wall splits and
punches through into open air, membrane wings catching the updraft and throwing long shadows across the field.
presses herself flat along the dragon's back, elbows tucked, chin down against the wind.
Heavy wingbeats and a long rush of air swallow the distant din of battle.
Wind lashes
's short hair across her brow as her face fills the frame beside the dark scaled curve of

's neck and the pale edge of a horn. Rain and grit bead on her cheek and along the faint linear mark there; the high collar of her tactical jacket rides against her jaw, straps and buckles rattling with each beat of the wings. Her eyes narrow and her jaw sets as concentration hardens into fierce resolve.
Her expression tightens; the flicker of uncertainty drains away and something stubborn and bright takes its place.
shifts her grip higher on the scaled ridge and braces her boots against the shoulder plates.
A thin high whistle of wind past her ear, and a strap buckle tapping in quick rhythm.
The dive bottoms out hard over the battleground:
snaps its wings wide, drags the air into a braking flare, and slams down onto broken stone, claws skidding through rubble as the body rears and the horned head swings up to roar.

stays low against its back, one arm hooked over the crest, jaw clenched against the shock. Smoke, embers and pulverised stone wash outward across the ruined field, and the scattered fires gutter sideways in the blast.
flares both wings to their widest span, membranes taut, and drops the last of the altitude in a controlled plunge.
Clawed limbs strike the stone; slabs crack and shear under the impact as the dragon rears up.
A bellowing roar rolls across the field, followed by the grind of stone beneath clawed feet.
Embers and pale dust wash past
, who raises a forearm to shield her eyes and stares forward into the smoke.
Battlefield clamour surges — shouts, metal, and rubble scattering across the ground.
